title: Education projects
intro1: Since 2008, the Brandenburg State Orchestra’s Förderverein programme has been supporting large-scale educational projects that open up the world of music to children and young people – and empower them to become creators in their own right.
intro2: These large-scale projects have very little funding of their own. Without external grants and generous sponsors, and without the support of Förderverein, these important projects would not be possible. Our aim is to **build bridges to culture** – for all children, regardless of their background or prior knowledge.
sf_teaser: A fixed format within our education work is the „Spannungsfelder" series – music, theatre and dance on social themes, together with pupils from Frankfurt (Oder) and the region.
infobox: **Funding from Förderverein and BSOF:** The educational projects are made possible by the association’s membership fees, as well as by donations and grants raised by the association.
mitmachen: As a member of Förderverein, you are helping to ensure that children and young people in Frankfurt (Oder) and the wider region have access to major cultural projects.
